title: Decision record
description: The record of ID.RA-06. One disposition on one branch (or a parent), with owner, date, residual, review, premises, and ADR fields. Approval scrutiny scales with irreversibility.

subject.description: The branch or parent this decides. A branch_id, risk_id, or obligation_id.

owner.description: The business owner who chose. Outside security.

residual.description: What is being carried after the response. For Accept, equals inherent.

review_trigger.description: The condition or date that re-opens this. For Accept, required (owner, date, review trigger).

fallback.description: A named fallback ('avoid; if refused on cost, mitigate with X and record the residual'). Never a second disposition.

premises.description: The inventory facts, control states and tolerance this decision rests on. Sensors re-open the decision when one moves.

ref.description: Slug/code/id of the thing the premise rests on.

state.description: The value at decision time. A sensor compares the current value to this.

reversibility.description: oDeshi ADR field. A one-way door gets a pre-mortem and explicit human authorization; a reversible choice does not.

validation.description: How we would know this decision was wrong.

dissent.description: First-class output. The overruled position is often the one the auditor asks about.

revisit_trigger.description: The condition that would prove the dissenter right.

alternative.description: Steelmanned rejected alternative. Required once at Moderate tier, 1–2 at Complex.

reopened.description: Appended when a premise moves. Each entry is an audit line, not a deletion.

reason.description: Which premise moved, from what to what.

authorized.description: Required for a one-way-door decision and for any Accept. Set only by a human action.
